WITH extended AS (
               UPDATE jobs
               SET lease_expires_at = now() + $4::bigint * interval '1 millisecond',
                   progress = COALESCE($5, progress)
               WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'running' AND claimed_by = $2 AND attempt = $3
               RETURNING id
           )
           SELECT status, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM extended) AS "extended!"
           FROM jobs
           WHERE id = $1
